defs.def: able to speak, read or write a language, especially a foreign language, easily and well （尤指外语）流利，文字流畅

ex.s: It suddenly became very clear to me how lucky I was to be fluent in two languages.
ex.t: 我突然非常清楚地意识到我能流利地说两种语言是多么幸运。

ex.s: be fluent in either English or French
I know that Chinese is a very difficult language, but I hope to be fluent when I graduate.
ex.t: 我知道中文是一门很难的语言，但我希望毕业时能够说一口流利的中文。

ex.s: As stated in my attached CV, I can speak both English and French fluently.
ex.t: 如我附上的简历所述，我能流利地说英语和法语。

ex.s: The majority of residents in Chinatown are still ethnic Chinese, many of whom do not speak English fluently.
ex.t: 唐人街的大多数居民仍然是华裔，他们中的许多人不能说流利的英语。

ex.s: Can you report others’ statements, requests, or questions fluently and accurately?
ex.t: 你能流利准确地转述他人的陈述、请求或问题吗？

ex.s: He gave me some great advice on how to improve my speaking so that I could speak more 5 fluency/ fluently and graduallyI started to speak with more confidence.
ex.t: 他给了我一些很好的建议，教我如何提高口语，使我能够说得更流利，渐渐地我开始更有信心地说了。

ex.s: Italians always “see me as a foreigner,” an outsider, even though she’s stayed in the country for years and can speak the local language fluently, she said.
ex.t: 意大利人总是"把我当作外国人"，一个局外人，尽管她在这个国家生活多年并且能流利地说当地语言，她说。

defs.def: expressed easily and well 语言，尤指外语
done in a smooth and skilful way 动作
